note: Village of Montour Falls municipal marina and campground on the canal to Seneca Lake; 20 full hookups. Geiger's Marine Services operates out of the marina. Availability by phone or the village's contact form; the office is closed Tuesday and Wednesday. --Claude
summary: Village page and 2025 rate sheet: confirmed phone 607-210-4124 and 50-amp full hookups; added fees $40 (electric-only) to $55 (50-amp full hookup), 2025, and season May 1 - Oct 15.
